atlases.prompt:
Use case illustration-story. Create a single square 2×2 atlas for an original Chinese first-grade math lesson, four exactly equal crop-ready quadrants, no divider or gutter, nothing crosses a midline. Approved palette warm oat cream, pine green, apricot orange, a bit of muted fern. Delicate paper grain, matte gouache, rounded cut-paper silhouettes, calm and very legible picture-book illustration. NO letters, numbers, text, brands, logos, math, patterned counting dots, watermarks anywhere.
Upper-left quadrant: two cheerful first-grade Chinese children at a small nature observation cabin, one child holds a blank cream clipboard, the other points at green leaves visible beyond a window. Warm wood counter and tidy pine trim. Children and interesting shapes on right, open light background on left. 
Upper-right quadrant: the empty nature observation cabin storeroom from very slightly overhead, muted warm light wood floor occupying central 80 percent; small mint shelves at distant top and far outer edges, no clutter in the middle. For board game background, keep floor softly even and quiet.
Lower-left quadrant: quiet field station reading room, calm pale wood floor central 80 percent, wide horizon window and forest shapes only along far top and outer edges. Clean low contrast and enough empty center for a falling-tile game board.
Lower-right quadrant: four fully isolated objects in an exact internal 2-by-2 grid against completely plain solid pale mint #d1ecda from edge to edge. Upper left low two-wheel orange rolling trolley side view. Upper right blank oval orange tile on a green clip. Lower left deep green rounded leaf merit badge. Lower right a single tan small pencil-box with pine-green cover. Each object centered in its invisible cell with at least 20 percent clear margin each side. No text, no shadows, nothing touches the bounds. No countable objects used as real math quantities; those will be overlaid by code.
